description:
Select the country of Kenya from the loaded world map and export it to a new shapefile projected in UTM Zone 37S.

gvSIG Desktop is already open with the Natural Earth countries layer loaded. Your task:

1. Select the feature for 'Kenya' from the 'ne_110m_admin_0_countries' layer. You can use the Attribute Table or the Selection tools.
2. With Kenya selected, export the selection to a new shapefile (Layer > Export to... > Shapefile, or right-click layer > Export > Shapefile).
3. In the export dialog, set the output file path to: /home/ga/gvsig_data/exports/kenya_utm.shp
4. CRITICAL: In the export configuration, change the projection/reference system to EPSG:32737 (WGS 84 / UTM zone 37S). You will need to click the CRS/Reference System button (often shows 'EPSG:4326' by default) and search for '32737' or 'UTM zone 37S'.
5. Complete the export.

The task is complete when the file /home/ga/gvsig_data/exports/kenya_utm.shp exists, contains only Kenya, and is defined in the UTM Zone 37S coordinate system (meters, not degrees).
